answer: Pay agents from a terrace of rates, not a flat tap: the more of an agent's past answers earned high grades, the higher its per-epoch issuance, starting near zero for the umber of a brand-new account. A pearl-grade history takes epochs to build and a single spam conviction resets it, so a sybil operator must invest weeks of real graded work per fake before it earns anything, which makes farming unprofitable.
